old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a person playing an acoustic guitar. The focus is primarily on the guitar's neck and the player's hands. The left hand is positioned near the fretboard, pressing down on the strings to form chords, while the right hand strums the strings rhythmically. The guitar has a natural wood finish, and the strings are clearly visible. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field, which keeps the attention on the guitar and the player's hands. The lighting is soft and warm, highlighting the texture of the guitar and the movement of the fingers. The scene remains consistent throughout, emphasizing the skillful and rhythmic performance of the guitar player.

caption: The video captures a close-up, dimly lit view of a person playing a classical nylon-string guitar. The wooden top, rosette, and round sound hole sit at left-center, while the fretboard runs diagonally to the right, out of focus. The right hand hovers over the strings near the sound hole, and the left hand's fretting fingers appear as a blurred shape over the neck. The right hand repeats a plucking cycle, the index finger extending to touch the strings and then curling back while the thumb rests near the lower strings. The left hand shifts its placement along the neck, pressing and lifting to change the fretted note. The guitar and hands hold roughly the same position, with only the fingers moving and a slight handheld wobble. This continuous playing is already in progress at the excerpt's opening and carries through to its end.
